quote: GPT-5.5 is here! Available in the API, Codex and ChatGPT today
kind_note: reasoning tier of GPT-5.5, offered under its own name and API id (gpt-5.5-pro); rolled out in ChatGPT alongside the base model
note: Lab (OpenAI) confirmed. The April 23, 2026 date for the Pro rollout to ChatGPT Pro, Business and Enterprise users comes from a search summary of https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5-5/, which I could not open (HTTP 403), so it is not a verbatim quote. The quote above is a headline on the OpenAI developer forum post, which I did open; it names GPT-5.5 and ChatGPT but not Pro specifically. Forum posts dated April 23 quote OpenAI as saying 'We'll bring GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5 Pro to the API very soon', so Pro was not in the API at launch. Sources conflict on the API date: one April 23 forum post says 'GPT-5.5-pro is also available in the Responses API', while the April 24 post confirms GPT-5.5 in the API without a Pro-specific date. Datalearner gives May 19, 2026, but says the model was not yet officially released, so I disregarded it. Not recorded: third-party pricing ($30/$180 per 1M tokens, unverified). Pro is a variant that OpenAI launched on the same day as the base model, so I did not classify it as tier; base_model would be GPT-5.5 if a strict tier reading is wanted. Verify the Pro-specific wording against OpenAI's page when it is reachable.
